metadata.scenario_context: A group of software development firms from different countries have initiated an interspersed project. They have planned to organize a consortium during early May.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Ireland strongly disagree they would never join strikes.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Kyrgyzstan strongly agree they would never join strikes.

agent_1.goal_1: Convene a discussion about scheduling the consortium on May 1st.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is common to discuss or join strikes as a form of protest.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to join strikes as a form of protest.

shared_prefix.speaker: Pedro
shared_prefix.message:
Hassan, have we settled on a date for the consortium? I think May 1st could work well for everyone. What do you think? 

Also, I've been curious... is it common in your circles to discuss or join strikes as a form of protest? Just wondering.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Hassan
shared_prefix.message:
May 1st... that’s a possibility, but I think we should consider how it fits with everyone’s schedules. Maybe we should discuss it further with the team?

As for strikes, well, in Kyrgyzstan, we don’t really join strikes. It’s not something we do. I think we prefer to find other ways to resolve issues.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Pedro
shared_prefix.message:
I get that, but I believe May 1st can be a solid option. It’s important to have a date set so we can get things moving. Maybe we can finalize this soon?

And that’s interesting about strikes. In Ireland, we strongly disagree with the idea of joining strikes. I’d rather focus on productive dialogue, honestly. So, can we push for May 1st?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Hassan
shared_prefix.message:
I understand you feel strongly about May 1st, but I still think we should consult with the rest of the group before finalizing it. It’s important to have everyone on board.

shared_prefix.label: transition
